title: Concept: Platform package faked for resolution
description: composer.json declares a `config.platform` entry that pretends an extension is absent, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `config.platform` entry that pretends an extension is absent.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `config.platform` entry that pretends an extension is absent.
